name: TSYS TS2 Simulation Schema
description: Synthetic credit card portfolio schema modelled on the TSYS TS2 card processing platform. Covers the full lifecycle: account origination, daily transactions, disputes, fraud management, collections, and credit scoring.

tables.name: ACCOUNT
tables.description: Credit card account — the central simulation entity

tables.name: CARD
tables.description: Physical or virtual card issued against an account

tables.name: CHARGEBACK
tables.description: Network-level chargeback escalated from a resolved dispute

tables.name: CLIENT
tables.description: Top-level issuing client (bank or financial institution)

tables.name: COLLECTION_CASE
tables.description: Active collections case for a delinquent account

tables.name: CUSTOMER
tables.description: Primary cardholder linked to an account

tables.name: FRAUD_ALERT
tables.description: System-generated fraud flag on a transaction

tables.name: PRODUCT_DEFINITION
tables.description: Card product with pricing, APR, limits, and rewards programme

tables.name: PROVIDER
tables.description: Portfolio provider belonging to a client

tables.name: SCORE_RECORD
tables.description: Monthly credit score snapshot per account

tables.name: STATEMENT
tables.description: Monthly billing statement for an account
